user.title: Crew Hub
user.description: Shows live Claude Code sessions reported by crew-hubd over MQTT. Each machine publishes under <prefix>/<machine>/.

error.invalid_prefix: Use 1-64 lower-case letters, digits, '-' or '_' (one topic level, no wildcards).

abort.single_instance_allowed: Crew Hub is already set up.
abort.already_configured: Crew Hub is already set up.

data_description.id: The machineId from the machine's crew-hub config (for example nas).
data_description.transport: MQTT for machines on the home network; webhook for machines that roam (they reach Home Assistant through its public URL).
data_description.secret: MQTT machines only: the same command secret as on the machine (at least 16 characters). Webhook machines get a generated secret.
data_description.public_url: Webhook machines only: the https:// address Home Assistant is reachable at from outside, without a path (for example https://hass.example.com).

pair.title: Pair {machine}
pair.description:
This pairing code is shown only once. On {machine}, run `crew-hub-pair` in your own terminal and paste it when asked (the input is hidden):

`{code}`

The code holds the machine's webhook address and secret, so don't share it or paste it into a chat. The machine is already saved; if you lose the code, re-pair it from Edit a machine.

data_description.secret: Leave empty to keep the current secret.

data_description.public_url: The https:// address put into the pairing code. A change reaches the machine only when you re-pair.
data_description.repair: Make a new webhook address and secret and show a new pairing code. The old code stops working at once.

error.machine_exists: A machine with this id already exists.
error.secret_too_short: The secret must be at least 16 characters.
error.invalid_public_url: Enter an https:// address without a path, for example https://hass.example.com.

send_message.name: Send message
send_message.description: Send a text message to a Claude Code session on a machine. Admin users only; automations and scripts without a user are refused.

machine.name: Machine
machine.description: Machine id as added in Crew Hub (for example nas). Works the same for MQTT and webhook machines.

session.name: Session
session.description: Local Claude Code session id, as listed in the machine's snapshot (sessions[].id).

text.name: Text
text.description: The message, up to 4000 characters. The session sees it prefixed with [From Isaac via Crew Hub].

urgent.name: Urgent
urgent.description: Deliver now, interrupting the current reply. Otherwise it is read after the current turn.

answer.name: Answer
answer.description: Answer a session's waiting permission prompt or question. Admin users only; automations and scripts without a user are refused.
